text: A bound is one name and one value, checked where a lock is loaded and where a proposal is pinned (#826). The gate writes each bound into TLC's config as CONSTANT Name = value, and TLC reads the config a token at a time, so a value holding a line end or a second value added a directive: a constraint naming an operator of the factory's made TLC check fewer states than the bounds say, while a proposal showed the bound on one line. A name is an identifier that isn't a config word, and a value is a number, a model value, a string, or a set or tuple of values, with nothing after it.
